purpose: Observed stream sensors in or next to the brawley-avra-west domain for the Nov 1-2 2026 event, mapped to model sections, to judge the v2x model against reality. Validation only, not forcing, no tuning.

domain.crsCheck: EPSG:32612 (UTM 12N) declared in the file; sensor lon/lat transformed with pyproj 4326->32612; the inlet USGS 09487000 lands 790 m outside the boundary, as expected for an upstream inlet

searchedSources.dataBranch: origin/data holds one force-pushed commit (14cb2a7, 2026-11-09T02:51Z): the snapshot workflow replaces it every ~10 min, so it has no Nov 1-2 history. Nothing was read from it except to confirm that.
searchedSources.pimaAlert: alertmap.rfcd.pima.gov currentstream.php (all stream sensors) and showdata.php (last 1000 reports per sensor, which reach back to late Sep-mid Oct 2026, so Nov 1-2 is fully covered).
searchedSources.usgs: waterservices.usgs.gov site service (bbox -111.55,31.90,-110.95,32.60, all stream sites) and IV service for every site with IV.

timeBasisCheck: ALERT pages are in Arizona MST: (1) the newest showdata row equals currentstream last_rpt, which tools/snapshot_alert.py treats as UTC-7 and which matched the data-branch snapshot fetched at 02:51Z; (2) ALERT 6423 jumps 0.41->2.12 ft at 14:00 local while the co-located USGS 09487000 (times stamped -07:00) jumps 66 -> 1570 cfs between 14:00 and 14:15 -07:00.

alert6443Claim.verdict: CONFIRMED value, CORRECTED time and context
alert6443Claim.context: 817 cfs is the 19:45 MST (02:45Z) report, on the falling limb of the third and smallest of three peaks. The event maximum at ALERT 6443 was 2286 cfs (64.732 m3/s) at 2026-11-01T18:20:00Z. The same value (817) also appears at 16:55 MST (23:55Z) on the first recession.
alert6443Claim.companionClaim: The owner's '1,160 cfs at Three Points' equals USGS 09487000 at 2026-11-02T02:00:00Z (19:00 MST, 1160.0 cfs), the latest USGS value an ALERT-map viewer would see at about 20:04 MST; ALERT 6423 at 19:45 MST read 748.0 cfs.

mileWideComparison.gauge: ALERT 6443, 4.8 m from NHD 15876815 (San Joaquin/Black Wash outlet, 604 km2); the Brawley 15877627 crossing is 0.8 km west. The model section that contains the gauge is the Black Wash 15876815 band; both-bands is the upper bound if the gauge saw the combined flow.
mileWideComparison.hourlyNote: observed = the report at the hour, or the latest earlier report with its age in minutes (no interpolation); model = v2x hourly restart flux across the section (m3/s); NWM = analysis_assim (ends 07Z Nov 2). Model hourly values exist from 18Z Nov 1.

volumeM3.method: trapezoid between reports (observed; linear across report gaps, which is an assumption) and between hourly fluxes (model)

stageRise.note: Observed stage is on the gauge datum (2.30 ft = zero flow), the model is zs on its cell. Only rises are comparable, and only roughly; this is not a water-level comparison.
